description: One postflop solver node: the acting player's strategy for every hand class, the legal next segments, board, reach and the reach-weighted action split. Walk deeper by appending a returned childSegment (an action like "Bet 5.5" or a runout like "deal:7c") to `path`.

combo.description: Optional exact combo, e.g. AsKh (PLO5: five cards, as listed in the node's hands)

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

pack.description: Pack id from list_postflop_packs. Use a sizingTrees packId to pick the tree: the pack id for 75% pot on the flop, or "<pack>-flop33" for 33%.

path.description: Segments from the root, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 5.5"]. Empty for the root node.

name: get_postflop_node

outputSchema.description: One postflop solver node: the acting player's strategy and the legal next segments.

actingPlayer.description: 0 for out of position, 1 for in position.

actionFreqs.description: Full detail: aggregate frequency per action.

items.description: Reach-weighted frequency for the action at this index.

actions.description: Actions at the node with their reach-weighted frequency.

items.description: One action available at a postflop node.

action.description: Action segment including its size, e.g. "Bet 5.5".

addBb.description: Chips this action adds, in big blinds.

comparisonKey.description: Size-normalised action key used to line two nodes up, e.g. "Bet 75% pot".

evBb.description: Action EV in big blinds where the pack publishes it.

evLossBb.description: EV given up against the best action, in big blinds.

sizePotPct.description: Bet size as a percent of the pot, bets only.

childSegments.description: Append one of these to `path` to walk deeper.

items.description: An action like "Bet 5.5" or a runout like "deal:7c".

columns.description: Column order for `hands`: combo, reach, frequencies, evBb, evLossBb, actionEvBb.

combo.description: The requested combo, when one was asked for.

hands.description: Compact rows in `columns` order, or the full per-combo strategy objects in full detail.

hint.description: How to narrow, page, or widen the same query.

node.description: Full detail: the stored node. Null at a chance point, where runouts hang directly under the path.

path.description: Segments walked from the root to this node.

potBb.description: Pot at this node in big blinds.

reach.description: Full detail: the acting player's per-combo reach.

items.description: A combo and its reach weight.

summary.description: What the compact range left out, so nothing looks complete when it is sampled.

classes.description: Postflop: hand classes with reach at the node.

matchingHands.description: plo5: classes that take the action before the cut.

mixedInReturned.description: plo5: mixed classes among the returned rows.

nonzeroHands.description: Hand classes with a frequency above 0.

omitted.description: Rows dropped by the compact cut.

pureInReturned.description: plo5: pure classes among the returned rows.

title: Get postflop solver node
